messages:
Nina: FYI - noticed daily invoice preview for eu-west is ~2.9% lower than final for a set of tenants after the priority-queue rollout last night.
Samir: which tenants / routes? any pattern?
Nina: primarily routes with shard-affinity and any tenant using route_hint=sticky. example: tenant 'velox' preview tokens=9,730, final tokens=10,003.
Jorge: did we change preview logic in the last deploy? I thought only route-resolver was touched.
Samir: we merged PR #5321 to tighten preview dedupe window (300s -> 120s) earlier this week to reduce duplicate retries.
Billing Bot: deploy-info: route-priority v1.1 @ 2024-09-01T01:10:12Z. enrichment_service v3.6 processed events: enrichment_latency_p95=0.98s, enrichment_missed=0.22%
Maya: enrichment_missed 0.22% is concerning when combined with a shorter dedupe window. that can cause enriched events to miss preview aggregation.
Ops Oncall: we had a transient pod churn in eu-west at 01:09 due to node upgrade; kube rescheduled ~45s of backpressure.
Jorge: sounds like race: ingress -> enrichment (delayed) -> preview dedupe drop -> final (later) includes enrichment.
Nina: I pulled one raw pair: ```{"ts":"2024-09-01T01:08:51Z","proxy":"shard-9","client":"t-velox","tokens":203}``` enriched later -> ```{"ts":"2024-09-01T01:08:51Z","route":"shard-9","tenant":"velox","tokens":203,"enrich_ts":"2024-09-01T01:08:52Z"}``` but preview aggr window trimmed it.
Samir: trimming? preview aggregator trims late-arrival beyond dedupe window and uses the earliest anchor for sessionization. if enrichment arrives after the dedupe window we consider it unresolvable.
Maya: is the aggregator using normalized_tokens for unitization? I remember a refactor in enrichment where "raw_token_count" got renamed to "token_count_norm" and we might double-apply Unicode NFC normalization.
Jorge: that could account for a few percent in some languages but not all. combined with dropped events it adds up.
Samir: immediate plan options: 1) roll preview dedupe back to 300s (hotfix) 2) replay the hour into preview with enrichment forced earlier 3) patch enrichment to keep explicit raw_token_count and add unit tests 4) add a dashboard tile matching per-route preview vs final delta.
Product: product impact? any tenants at risk of billing disputes?
Nina: flagged tenants list includes velox, molecula-inc, and a handful of EU test accounts. CSMs notified provisional hit.
Billing Bot: applying hotfix: preview_dedupe_window set to 300s at 2024-09-01T01:25:03Z by Ops.
Ops Oncall: kicked off replay job rp-20240901-eu-01, running ingest replay into ledger-preview-v3 with enrichment staged earlier. ETA ~10m.
Samir: also can we add a canary guard to block route-priority rollouts if enrichment_p95 > 600ms in the first 10 minutes?
Maya: yes, we can add that to the deployment pipeline. filing infra ticket infra-2022.
Jorge: for observability: ui-9090 to add a small console card: "preview_delta_by_route" showing rolling 1h delta and a filter for enrichment_latency. useful during rollouts.
Nina: replay done. summary: original preview showed -2.9% tokens for flagged tenants in the 01:00-02:00 window; after replay with earlier enrichment, preview aligns to final within 0.1%.
Samir: replay result strongly indicates the late enrichment + shorter dedupe window root cause. we still need the raw_token_count fix to avoid secondary normalization deltas.
Maya: created PR to emit raw_token_count from enrichment_v3.7 and added unit tests for NFC/NFD normalization edge cases. PR #5389.
Product: suggested communication: notify affected customers with a short explanation + offer to correct any disputed invoices for that window.
Nina: will draft brief and pass to CSMs.
Billing Bot: incident-note: preview_dedupe_rollback_and_replay_completed at 2024-09-01T02:05:00Z
Ops Oncall: follow-ups: infra-2022 (canary guard), ui-9090 (console tile), ops-3333 (replay runbook improvements).
Samir: set alert: enrichment_missed > 0.15% OR enrichment_p95 > 500ms for 5m => page oncall and notify platform.
Jorge: adding a post-rollout checklist so next route-resolver/prio rollout includes a preview-vs-final sanity check.
Nina: thanks team. big win catching this quickly. :sparkles:
Product: closing loop - will coordinate customer comms and confirm resolved in 24h.
Billing Bot: incident-resolved at 2024-09-01T02:10:12Z
